claims.title: The trading town of Birka
claims.summary: Birka on the island of Björkö in Lake Mälaren flourished as a key Baltic trading settlement, connecting Scandinavia by river route to the Byzantine Empire and the Islamic world, before its abandonment in the late tenth century.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-750-the-trading-town-of-birka, claim TL:SWE:event:750:the-trading-town-of-birka, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Ansgar's mission and the first Christian congregation
claims.summary: The Frankish missionary Ansgar founded at Birka the earliest known Christian congregation in Sweden, the first organised Christian presence among a still largely pagan people.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-830-ansgar-s-mission-and-the-first-christian, claim TL:SWE:event:830:ansgar-s-mission-and-the-first-christian, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Rus and the eastern river routes
claims.summary: Swedish Norsemen, called Varangians or Rus, opened and dominated the river trade routes east through Ladoga and Novgorod toward Constantinople and Baghdad, exchanging furs, silver and slaves.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-860-the-rus-and-the-eastern-river-routes, claim TL:SWE:event:860:the-rus-and-the-eastern-river-routes, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Christianization advances under royal patronage
claims.summary: The conversion of the Swedes proceeded through the eleventh century by way of baptised kings and the founding of churches, even as paganism endured at the temple of Uppsala until the faith finally prevailed.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1008-christianization-advances-under-royal-patronage, claim TL:SWE:event:1008:christianization-advances-under-royal-patronage, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Formation of the Kalmar Union
claims.summary: Queen Margaret united Denmark, Norway and Sweden under one monarch, her grandnephew Erik of Pomerania, creating a Scandinavian union intended to resist German power but soon dominated by Denmark.

sources.label: Queen Margaret and the Union of Kalmar

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1397-formation-of-the-kalmar-union, claim TL:SWE:event:1397:formation-of-the-kalmar-union, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Swedish revolts and the Sture regents
claims.summary: Resentment of Danish dominance and of taxes and offices given to royal favourites fuelled recurring Swedish risings, with regents of the Sture family ruling Sweden in defiance of the union crown.

sources.label: Queen Margaret and the Union of Kalmar

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1434-swedish-revolts-and-the-sture-regents, claim TL:SWE:event:1434:swedish-revolts-and-the-sture-regents, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Stockholm Bloodbath
claims.summary: After capturing Stockholm and breaking his promise of amnesty, King Christian II of Denmark had some eighty-two Swedish nobles, clergy and citizens condemned as heretics and executed, including Gustav Vasa's father.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1520-the-stockholm-bloodbath, claim TL:SWE:event:1520:the-stockholm-bloodbath, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Swedish War of Liberation
claims.summary: Gustav Vasa raised Dalarna in revolt against Christian II, leading a peasant army that expelled the Danes and was declared regent of Sweden, ending Danish control of the realm.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1521-the-swedish-war-of-liberation, claim TL:SWE:event:1521:the-swedish-war-of-liberation, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Gustav Vasa elected king
claims.summary: The Estates meeting at Strängnäs elected Gustav Vasa king of Sweden, dissolving the Kalmar Union and founding the hereditary Vasa monarchy that is regarded as the start of the modern Swedish state.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1523-gustav-vasa-elected-king, claim TL:SWE:event:1523:gustav-vasa-elected-king, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Reign of Gustav I Vasa
claims.summary: Gustav Vasa built a centralised national monarchy, restored royal finances, suppressed revolts and founded the Vasa dynasty, ruling for nearly four decades as the architect of the modern Swedish kingdom.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1523-reign-of-gustav-i-vasa, claim TL:SWE:event:1523:reign-of-gustav-i-vasa, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The Reformation at Västerås
claims.summary: At the Riksdag of Västerås, Gustav Vasa broke with Rome, transferred the Catholic Church's property to the crown and took control of church administration, beginning Sweden's transformation into a Lutheran state.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1527-the-reformation-at-vasteras, claim TL:SWE:event:1527:the-reformation-at-vasteras, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The complete Swedish Bible
claims.summary: The first full Bible in Swedish, the work of the reformers Olaus and Laurentius Petri, was printed, advancing the Lutheran cause and shaping the Swedish written language and popular literacy.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1541-the-complete-swedish-bible, claim TL:SWE:event:1541:the-complete-swedish-bible, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The crown made hereditary
claims.summary: The Estates declared the Swedish crown hereditary in the Vasa line, ending the older elective principle and entrenching the dynasty's hold on the throne.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1544-the-crown-made-hereditary, claim TL:SWE:event:1544:the-crown-made-hereditary, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Sweden enters the Thirty Years' War
claims.summary: Gustavus Adolphus landed in Pomerania and intervened on the Protestant side, turning the tide of the Thirty Years' War with a series of victories before his death at Lützen in 1632.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1630-sweden-enters-the-thirty-years-war, claim TL:SWE:event:1630:sweden-enters-the-thirty-years-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Peace of Westphalia
claims.summary: The settlement ending the Thirty Years' War granted Sweden Western Pomerania, Bremen and Verden and a vote in the imperial diet, confirming it as a dominant power on the Baltic and in northern Germany.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1648-peace-of-westphalia, claim TL:SWE:event:1648:peace-of-westphalia, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Treaty of Roskilde
claims.summary: After Charles X Gustav's invasion of Denmark, the Treaty of Roskilde forced Denmark to cede Scania, Blekinge, Halland and Bohuslän to Sweden, fixing its southern border and marking the empire's territorial peak.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1658-treaty-of-roskilde, claim TL:SWE:event:1658:treaty-of-roskilde, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Battle of Poltava
claims.summary: Peter the Great of Russia routed Charles XII's invading army at Poltava in Ukraine, a decisive defeat that broke Swedish military power and began Russian supremacy in eastern Europe.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1709-battle-of-poltava, claim TL:SWE:event:1709:battle-of-poltava, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Treaty of Nystad ends the empire
claims.summary: The peace ending the Great Northern War ceded Sweden's Baltic provinces — Estonia, Livonia, Ingria and part of Karelia — to Russia, ending the age of greatness, though Finland was restored to Sweden.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1721-treaty-of-nystad-ends-the-empire, claim TL:SWE:event:1721:treaty-of-nystad-ends-the-empire, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Treaty of Fredrikshamn: the loss of Finland
claims.summary: Ending the Finnish War, the Treaty of Fredrikshamn (Hamina) ceded the whole of Finland and the Åland Islands to Russia, stripping Sweden of about a third of its territory and people.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1809-treaty-of-fredrikshamn-the-loss-of-finland, claim TL:SWE:event:1809:treaty-of-fredrikshamn-the-loss-of-finland, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Bernadotte chosen as heir
claims.summary: The French marshal Jean-Baptiste Bernadotte was elected Swedish crown prince, founding the Bernadotte dynasty; he ruled from 1818 as Charles XIV John, king of Sweden and Norway.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1810-bernadotte-chosen-as-heir, claim TL:SWE:event:1810:bernadotte-chosen-as-heir, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Treaty of Kiel and the union with Norway
claims.summary: Denmark ceded Norway to Sweden by the Treaty of Kiel; Norwegian resistance produced not annexation but a personal union of the two kingdoms under one crown, lasting until 1905.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1814-treaty-of-kiel-and-the-union-with-norway, claim TL:SWE:event:1814:treaty-of-kiel-and-the-union-with-norway, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The great emigration to America
claims.summary: Driven by rural poverty and population growth, roughly 1.3 million Swedes emigrated, chiefly to the United States, in one of the largest population movements of the age, reshaping Swedish society at home.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1846-the-great-emigration-to-america, claim TL:SWE:event:1846:the-great-emigration-to-america, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Peaceful dissolution of the union with Norway
claims.summary: After Norway's parliament declared the union dissolved, Sweden agreed at Karlstad to a peaceful separation, recognising Norwegian independence without war in a settlement held up as a diplomatic model.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1905-peaceful-dissolution-of-the-union-with-norway, claim TL:SWE:event:1905:peaceful-dissolution-of-the-union-with-norway, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Universal suffrage and democracy
claims.summary: Sweden completed its democratic transformation, introducing universal and equal suffrage for men and women, as the Riksdag rather than the crown became the centre of political power.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1921-universal-suffrage-and-democracy, claim TL:SWE:event:1921:universal-suffrage-and-democracy, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: The 'people's home' (folkhemmet)
claims.summary: Per Albin Hansson set out the vision of Sweden as a folkhemmet, a good home built on equality and mutual care, which the Social Democrats made the foundation of the modern welfare state.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1928-the-people-s-home-folkhemmet, claim TL:SWE:event:1928:the-people-s-home-folkhemmet, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Neutrality in the Second World War
claims.summary: Sweden preserved its neutrality through the Second World War, remaining unoccupied while continuing controversial trade with Germany and offering refuge to those fleeing Nazi persecution.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1939-neutrality-in-the-second-world-war, claim TL:SWE:event:1939:neutrality-in-the-second-world-war, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Accession to the European Union
claims.summary: After the end of the Cold War made strict neutrality obsolete, Sweden joined the European Union, while choosing to keep its own currency rather than adopt the euro.
claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-1995-accession-to-the-european-union, claim TL:SWE:event:1995:accession-to-the-european-union, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.

claims.title: Sweden joins NATO
claims.summary: Prompted by Russia's invasion of Ukraine, Sweden abandoned over two centuries of non-alignment and became NATO's 32nd member on 7 March 2024, gaining the protection of Article 5.

sources.label: Swedish flag raised at NATO Headquarters

claims.citation: Terralore, "The Chronicle of Sweden: From Viking traders on the eastern rivers to a Baltic empire, a long neutrality, and at last into NATO.", terralore.co/country/SWE/chronicle#ev-2024-sweden-joins-nato, claim TL:SWE:event:2024:sweden-joins-nato, retrieved <YYYY-MM-DD>.
